metas.name: Octonauts
metas.description: Combines high-stakes undersea exploration with real marine biology, perfect for fans of The Magic School Bus and Special Agent Oso.

metas.name: Wild Kratts
metas.description: Focuses on zoology and animal 'creature powers,' aligning with the educational STEM themes found in Ada Twist, Scientist.

metas.name: Ask the StoryBots
metas.description: Answering kids' biggest questions with music and humor, it shares the inquisitive spirit of Numberblocks and Ada Twist.

metas.name: Daniel Tiger's Neighborhood
metas.description: Offers gentle social-emotional lessons similar to Bluey, focusing on navigating feelings and family life.

metas.name: Cyberchase
metas.description: Uses adventure and mystery to teach complex mathematical concepts, perfect for fans of Peg + Cat and Numberblocks.

metas.name: Molly of Denali
metas.description: Teaches informational text skills and indigenous culture through the lens of a young girl's adventures in Alaska.

metas.name: Arthur
metas.description: A long-running classic that deals with childhood social dynamics and family life with heart and humor, much like Bluey.

metas.name: Phineas and Ferb
metas.description: Features clever, layered humor that appeals to both kids and parents, similar to the witty writing of The Simpsons.

metas.name: Trash Truck
metas.description: A gentle, imaginative show about a boy and his giant truck friend that matches the cozy vibe of Clifford the Big Red Dog.

metas.name: Puffin Rock
metas.description: Beautifully animated and educational, it follows young puffins learning about their island home and nature.

metas.name: Dinosaur Train
metas.description: Mixes a child's love of trains and dinosaurs with actual paleontology and natural history facts.

metas.name: Team Umizoomi
metas.description: An interactive show that emphasizes 'Mighty Math Powers,' making it a great companion to Numberblocks and Peg + Cat.

metas.name: Sid the Science Kid
metas.description: Uses the scientific method to explore preschool-level questions, very similar in tone to Ada Twist, Scientist.

metas.name: Blaze and the Monster Machines
metas.description: Integrates physics and engineering concepts into high-speed races, appealing to fans of Special Agent Oso's gadgets.

metas.name: Super Why!
metas.description: An interactive literacy show that helps kids solve 'super big' problems through reading, similar to WordGirl.

metas.name: Hilda
metas.description: Features a fearless explorer and a cast of mythical creatures in a world that values kindness and understanding.

metas.name: Craig of the Creek
metas.description: Celebrates the power of childhood imagination and outdoor play with a diverse and charming cast of characters.

metas.name: We Bare Bears
metas.description: A wholesome and humorous show about three bear brothers trying to fit into modern human society.

metas.name: Tumble Leaf
metas.description: A visually stunning stop-motion series that encourages discovery and scientific play for young viewers.

metas.name: Martha Speaks
metas.description: Follows a talking dog who learns to communicate after eating alphabet soup, with a heavy focus on vocabulary similar to WordGirl.

metas.name: Ready Jet Go!
metas.description: An astronomy-based show that teaches space science through the eyes of an alien kid living on Earth.

metas.name: DuckTales
metas.description: A high-energy reboot that focuses on family bonds and grand adventures, appealing to fans of classic family animation.

metas.name: The Magic School Bus Rides Again
metas.description: A modern update to the original series that continues the tradition of making science fun and accessible.

metas.name: Sheriff Callie's Wild West
metas.description: Uses a Western setting to teach lessons about honesty, manners, and being a good friend.

metas.name: Vampirina
metas.description: Focuses on a girl whose family moves to a new town, emphasizing themes of acceptance and being yourself.

metas.name: Miles from Tomorrowland
metas.description: A space-themed show that highlights STEM careers and the importance of family working together.

metas.name: Recess
metas.description: A smart look at schoolyard social structures that captures the childhood humor also found in shows like Hey Arnold!.

metas.name: Hey Arnold!
metas.description: A grounded and empathetic slice-of-life show that deals with family and community, similar in depth to Bluey.

metas.name: Rugrats
metas.description: An iconic show that looks at the world from a toddler's perspective, focusing on the importance of friendship and play.

metas.name: Doug
metas.description: A relatable coming-of-age story about a boy navigating school, family, and his own imagination.

metas.name: The Proud Family
metas.description: A vibrant family sitcom that balances comedy with meaningful lessons about growing up and cultural identity.

metas.name: Go, Diego, Go!
metas.description: An animal-centric spinoff focusing on wildlife rescue and environmental science for a young audience.

metas.name: Bubble Guppies
metas.description: A preschool musical comedy that covers topics ranging from dinosaurs to dental hygiene in a fun format.

metas.name: Wonder Pets!
metas.description: Teaches teamwork through opera-inspired musical adventures where classroom pets rescue animals in trouble.

metas.name: Blue's Clues & You!
metas.description: The modern revival of the classic mystery show that encourages active observation and critical thinking.

metas.name: The Loud House
metas.description: Focuses on the chaotic but loving dynamics of a large family, appealing to fans of Bluey and King of the Hill.

metas.name: Animaniacs
metas.description: Features fast-paced, witty humor and educational segments that the whole family can enjoy together.

metas.name: Kim Possible
metas.description: A smart, action-oriented comedy about a girl balancing life as a high schooler and a world-class hero.

metas.name: Hero Elementary
metas.description: A group of students at a school for superheroes use the 'Superpowers of Science' to solve problems.

metas.name: Elinor Wonders Why
metas.description: Encourages young children to follow their curiosity about the natural world, much like Curious George.
